evidence.observation: Growth temperature steady at 749-751 °C after a brief 760 °C overshoot at the ramp-to-growth transition; the ramp tracked its setpoint closely.
Steady at about 45%, consistent with holding temperature.
Argon flow at about 100 sccm, matching the setpoint.
Steady at about 760 Torr (atmospheric). At atmospheric pressure the gauge would not reveal a seal leak or air getting in.
The exhaust O2 sensor, which the growth stage requires, is not installed, so oxygen contamination of the atmosphere cannot be checked.

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading, or another oxygen or leak check such as a leak-rate test or a portable O2 analyzer on the exhaust, to confirm the growth atmosphere is inert. After that, characterization of the sample.
